d: Explosions have rocked several areas in southern Iran, including Qeshm Island in the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz, raising fears of a fresh escalation in the US-Iran conflict. Iranian state media has not confirmed missile strikes, while the Revolutionary Guards Navy says two oil tankers caught fire after hitting mines while attempting to cross an unauthorised route. The developments come days after US strikes on Qeshm Island and as Washington enforces a blockade on Iranian ports. With Donald Trump facing the aftermath of the US midterm elections, could military action resume? And…
